yearlyMessage: Focus on The Love of The Lord
intro: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus.
outro: You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: For God so loved the world.
days.teaching: Giving is proof. Month focus — The Cross — Ultimate Demonstration: Gave Himself for us. This week we carry "Think on These Things" (Philippians 4:8). Deeper Love for All Humanity flows from being loved first. Let John 3:16 settle you: For God so loved the world.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Shed Your love abroad in my heart. Let me see people through the eyes of Jesus.
days.declaration: I am a conduit of God’s love to humanity today.
days.decree: I am a conduit of God’s love to humanity today. For God so loved the world. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Do one deliberate kindness for someone unlovable or overlooked.
days.audioScript: Good morning, family of God. Welcome to today’s decree on the love of the Lord. Month focus — The Cross — Ultimate Demonstration: Gave Himself for us. This week we carry "Think on These Things" (Philippians 4:8). Deeper Love for All Humanity flows from being loved first. Let John 3:16 settle you: For God so loved the world. Now declare: I am a conduit of God’s love to humanity today. For God so loved the world. In Jesus’ name, Amen. You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: While still sinners, Christ died.
days.teaching: No audition. Month focus — The Cross — Ultimate Demonstration: Gave Himself for us. This week we carry "Think on These Things" (Philippians 4:8). Wisdom for the Abundant Life flows from being loved first. Let Romans 5:8 settle you: While still sinners, Christ died.

days.decree: I walk in Kingdom abundance to be a blessing. While still sinners, Christ died. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Review one money choice; give or save as worship today.

days.verse: Who loved me and gave himself for me.
days.teaching: Personal ransom. Month focus — The Cross — Ultimate Demonstration: Gave Himself for us. This week we carry "Think on These Things" (Philippians 4:8). Spiritual Warfare (Praying the Scriptures) flows from being loved first. Let Galatians 2:20 settle you: Who loved me and gave himself for me.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. I put on the whole armour of God. No weapon formed against me shall prosper (Isaiah 54:17). I trample all the power of the enemy (Luke 10:19) and pull down every stronghold (2 Corinthians 10:4-5). Angels guard me in all my ways (Psalm 91:11).
days.declaration: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today.
days.decree: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today. Who loved me and gave himself for me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Speak Ephesians 6:10-11 aloud; cancel one fear by name.
